an4.184:1.1: Atha kho Jāṇussonī brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.184:1.2: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jāṇussonī brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca : Ahaṃ
an4.184:2.2: n' atthi yo so maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassāti.
an4.184:2.3: Atthi brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:2.4: Atthi pana brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa. 2.
an4.184:3.1: Katamo ca brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa?
an4.184:3.2: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho,
an4.184:3.3: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:3.4: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:3.5: piyā vata maṃ kāmā jahissanti piye vāhaṃ kāme jahissāmīti.
an4.184:3.6: So socati kilamati paridevati uratthalaṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:3.7: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa. 3.
an4.184:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco kāye avītarāgo hoti . . .
an4.184:4.2: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:4.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:4.4: piyo vata maṃ kāyo jahissati piyaṃ vāhaṃ kāyaṃ jahissāmīti.
an4.184:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso,
an4.184:5.2: tam enam aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:5.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:5.4: akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ akataṃ kusalaṃ akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ,
an4.184:5.5: kataṃ pāpaṃ kataṃ luddaṃ kataṃ kibbisaṃ.
an4.184:5.6: Yāvatā bho akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmīti.
an4.184:5.7: So socati kilamati paridevati uratthalaṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:5.8: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa. 5.
an4.184:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco kaṅkhī hoti vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme,
an4.184:6.2: tam enam aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:6.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:6.4: kaṅkhī vat' amhi vicikicchī aniṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme ti.
an4.184:6.5: So socati kilamati paridevati uratthalaṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:6.6: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno bhāyati santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:6.7: Ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro maraṇadhammā samānā bhāyanti santāsaṃ āpajjanti maraṇassa. 6.
an4.184:7.1: Kātamo ca brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa?
an4.184:7.2: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco kāmesu vītarāgo hoti vigatachando vigatapemo . . .
an4.184:7.3: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:7.4: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:7.5: piyā vata maṃ kāmā jahissanti piye vāhaṃ kāme jahissāmīti.
an4.184:7.6: So na socati na kīlamati na paridevati na uratthalaṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:7.7: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa. 7.
an4.184:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco kāye vītarāgo hoti vigatachando . . .
an4.184:8.2: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:8.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:8.4: piyo vata maṃ kāyo jahissati piyaṃ vāhaṃ kāyaṃ jahissāmīti.
an4.184:8.5: So na socati na kilamati na paridevati na uratthalaṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:8.6: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa. 8.
an4.184:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo hoti katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo,
an4.184:9.2: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:9.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:9.4: akataṃ vata me pāpaṃ akataṃ luddaṃ akataṃ kibbisaṃ,
an4.184:9.5: kataṃ kalyāṇaṃ kataṃ kusalaṃ katam bhīruttāṇaṃ.
an4.184:9.6: Yāvatā bho akatapāpāṇaṃ akataluddānaṃ akatakibbisānaṃ katakalyāṇānaṃ katakusalānaṃ katabhīruttāṇānaṃ gati taṃ gatim pecca gacchāmīti.
an4.184:9.7: So na socati na kilamati na paridevati na uratthalaṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:9.8: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjanti maraṇassati. 9.
an4.184:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco akaṅkhī hoti avecikicchī niṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme,
an4.184:10.2: tam enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rogātaṅko phusati.
an4.184:10.3: Tass' aññatarena gāḷhena rogātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti:
an4.184:10.4: akaṅkhī vat' amhi avecikicchī niṭṭhaṅgato saddhamme ti.
an4.184:10.5: So na socati na kilamati na paridevati na uratthalaṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.184:10.6: Ayam pi kho brāhmaṇa maraṇadhammo samāno na bhāyati na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassa.
an4.184:10.7: Ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro maraṇadhammā samānā na bhāyanti na santāsaṃ āpajjati maraṇassāti.
an4.184:11.1: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama . . . Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃgatan ti. 185. 1.
